title: Tangential boundary behavior in Hilbert spaces of analytic functions
summary: Sarason's Hilbert space version of Carathéodory-Julia Theorem connects the non-tangential boundary behavior of functions in de Branges-Rovnyak space $H(b)$ with the existence of angular derivatives in the sense of Carathéodory for $b$, an analytic self-mapping of the unit disk. In this article, we continue the study of higher order extensions of this result that deal with derivatives of functions in $H(b)$, and we consider notions of approach regions more general than the non-tangential ones.
